
## Install

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **macOS will ask you to confirm Mitra: when you first open it, and again after each update.**
> Mitra is free and isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID, so macOS can't verify it. Both
> prompts are expected and safe to allow; all of the source is here to check.
>
> - **Open Anyway.** macOS blocks each newly downloaded version until you click **Open Anyway** in
>   **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security** (step 2 below).
> - **Your Mac's password or Touch ID, usually twice.** Mitra keeps your MirAIe sign-in and session
>   in your Mac's Keychain, and macOS only lets the app that saved an item read it. Without a
>   Developer ID, macOS can't tell that a new version is the same app, so after each update it
>   asks once for each of the two saved items. Choose **Always Allow**; it won't ask again until the
>   next update.


1. Download **Mitra-for-MirAIe-<version>.dmg** below, open it, and drag **Mitra for MirAIe** into
   **Applications**.
2. Open it from Applications. macOS says it can't verify the app. Click **Done**, open **System
   Settings ▸ Privacy & Security**, scroll down to **Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to
   "Mitra for MirAIe was blocked".
3. Click the AC icon in the menu bar and sign in with your MirAIe mobile number or email.

**Updating from an earlier version?** Use **Update** in Mitra's panel (or download the DMG above)
and replace the app in Applications. When you open the new version, click **Open Anyway** as in
step 2, then enter your Mac's password or use Touch ID when macOS asks (usually twice) and choose
**Always Allow**. This happens after every update, as explained above.

Requires macOS 26 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Downloaded builds don't include the
widgets and Control Center toggle; build from source with your own Apple developer team to get
them.
